name: Mixology
summary:
It's your first day bartending, and you've decided to make your own menu with your own custom cocktails. Sounds like a chore, but thankfully, your favorite coworker is there to try and rate each of your drinks so you don't have to. And hey, that's quite a good thing considering some of the... adverse effects they cause.

This game is about a 20+ minute experience containing original pixel artwork and 56 drink combinations with unique dialogue!
